title: Hold a commercial television broadcasting licence
what: Providing a commercial television broadcasting service needs a licence from the ACMA.

sources.title: Broadcasting Services Act 1992
sources.quote: A person must not provide a commercial television broadcasting service unless the person has a licence to provide that service.

sources.title: Broadcasting Services Act 1992
sources.quote: A person must not provide a commercial television broadcasting service unless the person has a licence to provide that service.

assessment.summary: Commercial broadcasting needs a licence; the number of commercial services in each area follows the ACMA's licence area plans.

marks.reason: A licence is needed, and the ACMA's licence area plans set how many commercial services each area can have: a cap on entry.
